title.en: Supplication when looking in a mirror

recitation.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ ِللهِ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِىْ فَحَسِّـنْ خُلُقِىْ

transliteration.id: alhamdulillaahi kamaa hassanta kholqii fahassin khuluqii
transliteration.en: alhamdulillaahi kamaa hassanta kholqii fahassin khuluqii

translation.id: Segala puji bagi Allah, baguskanlah budi pekertiku sebagaimana Engkau telah membaguskan rupa wajahku
translation.en: All praise is for Allah. Make my character beautiful just as You made my appearance beautiful.
